hazards.description: Brand-new quest (released 3 Nov 2026, 17 days old): the walkthrough is still being edited and its two dungeons were not reviewed for aggressive NPCs.
Port Piscarilius prison cell is teleport-blocked; the exit is a plank and a gap in the north wall, and being caught by a guard returns you to the cell.
The ambush is a scripted knock-out cutscene, not a fight; no kills are listed.

lethality.rationale: No documented damage source, but the quest visits two dungeons whose walkthrough was not reviewed for aggressive monsters and the page is still changing. Rated 2 rather than 0/1 because absence of documentation is not proof of safety.

pvp.rationale: Kourend and Land's End; no Wilderness.

escape.rationale: The prison cell blocks teleports; you leave only through the wall gap, and guards send you back.

attention.rationale: Quest dialogue and sneaking past guards; periodic attention.

disconnect.rationale: No combat documented; a disconnect is at worst a lost step.

unpredictability.rationale: Brand-new mechanics (under 30 days old) per the anchor.

exposure.rationale: A single quest, well under a few hours.

knowledge.rationale: Content under 30 days old; T2-only requirements; walkthrough not reviewed end to end.

hw_death_classification.note: No T1 safe exception covers this quest; any death would be official. NO_DEATH_POSSIBLE is not claimed because the dungeons were not reviewed.

mitigations.action: Re-read the current wiki walkthrough on the day you start; if it now shows any fight, aggressive monster or damage source not listed here, stop and ask for a re-rating before continuing.
Start at full HP with 6+ food and a teleport for use outside the cell; never enter the prison area below 40 HP.

preconditions.food: 6 pieces of mid-heal food (e.g. 12+ HP each)
stop_conditions: Stop if the walkthrough shows a fight or damage source not described here
Leave the dungeon if HP falls below 30 and you do not know why you are taking damage

entries.bailout: In the cell, do not try to teleport: remove the plank and climb out through the north-wall gap, then walk away from the guards before teleporting. Anywhere else, teleport out and re-read the walkthrough.
entries.verdict_reason: Residual sits at the NEW_CONTENT floor (25). No documented damage, but the content is 17 days old; the re-read before starting is mandatory.

attention.rationale: Safespot positioning and obstacle crossings need constant attention.

disconnect.rationale: Aggressive snake: a 60-second in-combat disconnect at Defence 1 could cost most of 48 HP (max 3 every attack).

unpredictability.rationale: RNG damage within known bounds for the snake.

knowledge.rationale: Obstacle fall damage and cave teleport behaviour are undocumented.

Desert travel: heat 1-10 every 24-132 s outside towns; aggressive level 63 crocodiles (max 6) along the River Elid and north of Sophanem.

disconnect.rationale: A disconnect without prayer inside the flashback leaves you in combat for up to 60 s against a guardian hitting up to 9 at Defence 1: likely fatal.

unpredictability.rationale: Guardian identity is weighted, not certain; random scarab swarms.

exposure.rationale: A long quest with desert travel: a few hours.

knowledge.rationale: Crusher damage unquantified; Possessed Priest max hit single-page.

hazards.description: Iban's Lair bridge jumps fail about 16% of the time at Agility 57-58 for up to 24 damage and drop you among aggressive Soulless; the north rope swing fails for up to 14.

Wall traps 5-14 on a failed disarm; standing in front of an armed trap 'will repeatedly hit very fast and could be fatal'; grid pits 15; swinging logs 6-13; Iban's red spikes 5-8 each, rapid, not blocked by prayer.
Three demons (91, max 9), three paladins (62, max 8), Kalrag (89, max 9, blocked by Protect from Melee); blessed spiders (max 4) pile on, and killing Kalrag stuns you about two seconds.
Whole quest is instanced; any instant teleport can be used to leave.

route_verdicts.reason: Every step is at or under the cap of 44 (S01 25, S02 21, S08 31, S09 36, S10 18, S11 18, S14 38). Conditions: every mandatory mitigation and stop condition on those steps, plus the general rules. S01 is NEW_CONTENT: re-read its walkthrough on the day.

Underground Pass (47), Regicide (47) and The Fremennik Trials (45) are above the cap of 44. Each needs the owner's explicit acceptance (ledger accept_risk). If any is declined, the safer options already in the plan are DP02 option A (skip the quest block) and DP08 option A (Pollnivneach S11 instead of S12/S13). S13 Rellekka (18) is approved only with the lyre from S12; without it, re-rate before using the Camelot road.

S23 (Werewolf course) is vetoed: residual 95 Critical, ONE_SHOT_POSSIBLE, repeated about 92 hours at 48 HP. The plan's safer alternatives (S09/S10/S11) cover the same levels. The route also carries S05/S06 above the cap. Show it for comparison only, never as a choice.

general_rules: Hardcore Worlds uses the Hardcore Group Ironman death rules: treat every death as run-ending. Only Koschei's 4th form in The Fremennik Trials is a safe death on this guide's steps (F-0001, F-0004, F-5002).
Never go AFK on any course. Break sessions into blocks of an hour or less; handle every random event at full HP, because a random-event death is official on Hardcore Worlds (F-0003, F-3012).

Rooftops with unpublished fail damage (Canifis, Seers', Ardougne): keep HP at 30+, eat at 30, stop laps below 20. Any single fail above 12 damage means stop and ask for a re-rating (F-5367, F-5368, F-3074).

Never step into the Wilderness: no Wilderness Agility Course, no West Ardougne lever, no Ice Plateau tablets. Wilderness PvP is live on Hardcore Worlds and a PK death is official (F-5366, F-4091, F-3011).
Never use the Werewolf Agility Course at current Hitpoints and Strength (F-3067, F-3068).

Do not count on the escape crystal on Agility courses: its documented scope is a list of minigames, it does not fire while you are moving, and its status-clearing is only announced. Carry it configured, but never lower a precaution because of it (F-0015, F-3018, F-5386, F-3020).

No player-owned house, Nightmare Zone or Rogues' Den maze: all are unsafe deaths on Hardcore Worlds. Set house teleports to 'Outside'; buy Graceful from Grace without entering the maze (F-4003, F-3013, F-5358, F-4016, F-5007).
Desert: travel by magic carpet with waterskins; never walk south of Pollnivneach or along the River Elid (crocodiles, heat) (F-3078, F-5373, F-3054).
Never drink a poison chalice for a boost: it can deal 49 damage against 48 HP (F-5352).

In any quest fight, have the correct protection prayer on before the fight starts and keep at least 20 prayer points; a disconnect leaves you in combat for up to 60 seconds and logout needs 9.6 s since the last hit (F-3021, F-3022).
Never put any lamp, tome or choosable reward into Defence (build rule; F-2015, F-2038 tracks the only forced Defence XP).

Brand-new content (The Writing's on the Wall, Hardcore Worlds rules) is volatile: re-check the walkthrough and the Hardcore Worlds safe list before acting on this guide after any game update (F-2006, F-0017).
Steps vetoed here (S17, S23, S24, S25) must not be offered as choices; steps above the cap (S05, S06, S12, S16) appear only with a red ribbon and the owner's recorded acceptance.
